articles.title: Fed expected to pause rate hikes ahead of US midterms
articles.desc: The US Federal Reserve's upcoming meeting is expected to result in steady interest rates. High inflation continues to challenge economic policies, with rates anticipated to rise later this year. The Federal Open Market Committee will analyze data amidst political considerations ahead of the midterm elections. Analysts believe that while inflation remains a concern, a cautious approach will likely be taken.

articles.title: Sinking profits turn China’s $3.5 trillion rout into trap
articles.desc: Chinese stocks are experiencing a significant selloff resulting in a loss of $3.5 trillion since May. Increased competition and declining demand have negatively impacted corporate profits across various industries. Many companies, including major technology firms, are under financial pressure, prompting them to seek additional funding. The third-quarter earnings reports have shown disappointing results, highlighting ongoing profitability concerns. Analysts remain cautious about the potential for economic recovery as consumption remains weak.

articles.title: What is the Budget and what could be in it?
articles.desc: Chancellor John Healey will set out his plans for UK taxes on 28 October.

articles.title: G-Sec yields at three-year peak, could climb to 7.75% by December
articles.desc: India's benchmark 10-year government bond yield is expected to reach 7.75% by December. This increase is influenced by high crude oil prices and tight liquidity conditions. Persistent bond supply and expectations of further monetary tightening are driving the yield higher. Foreign portfolio investors have sold significant amounts of Indian debt, contributing to market instability. Economic concerns are spreading across emerging markets due to the interplay of oil prices and yields.

articles.title: Double-digit growth seen on corporate scoreboard in Q2, but bank, IT, pharma lag
articles.desc: September quarter earnings exhibited significant revenue and profit growth for various companies in key sectors. Revenue rose by 22.1% with net profit increasing by 27.5%, surpassing the previous quarter. However, banking, IT, and pharmaceuticals sectors experienced a slow down in growth rates. Excluding lending, operating margins improved, indicating stronger performance in non-banking sectors. Analysts expect 13 out of 18 sectors to deliver double-digit sales growth in the coming quarters.

articles.title: Global Market Today: Asian shares slip as AI jitters deepen ahead of big tech earnings
articles.desc: MSCI Inc.’s Asia Pacific equities gauge fell 0.2% ahead of this season’s busiest earnings week in Asia. US equity-index futures erased earlier gains and traded little changed.

articles.title: India valuations hit 6-year low, but stocks still expensive than EM peers
articles.desc: India's equity valuations have reached their lowest levels in six years after a recent market decline. Factors contributing to this decline include foreign selling, a weaker rupee, and rising crude prices. Despite lower valuations, overseas investors remain hesitant to invest in Indian equities due to comparative valuations. The MSCI India Index trades at a premium compared to other emerging markets, influencing foreign investor sentiment.

articles.title: D-St set for a cautious opening as GIFT Nifty signals muted start
articles.desc: Benchmark indices experienced a decline on Friday due to high Brent crude oil prices and global market weakness. Nifty was noted to face immediate resistance at 22,850 levels, with previous week's high acting as a hurdle. The rupee fell against the dollar for the second consecutive day, impacted by rising crude prices. Foreign portfolio investors were net buyers, while domestic institutional investors also increased their holdings.

Various factors, including selling by foreign investors and rising crude oil prices, have contributed to this downturn. Notable stocks such as Infosys and Kotak Mahindra Bank have attracted investor attention due to their quarterly earnings. Upcoming developments may influence market sentiment further as investors remain watchful.

articles.title: BlackRock stays cautious on Indian equities despite cheaper valuations
articles.desc: BlackRock Investment Institute has not yet adopted a bullish stance on Indian equities due to ongoing uncertainties. The firm anticipates greater clarity on corporate earnings and energy prices before changing its outlook. Despite elevated energy costs, India's economic resilience remains noteworthy amidst geopolitical tensions. Foreign investors have been net sellers of Indian equities for several months, impacting market performance.

articles.title: IPO rush continues: 9 issues to raise Rs 2,768 crore this week
articles.desc: In the upcoming week, the market gears up for an exciting round of initial public offerings, featuring five mainboard IPOs and four small and medium enterprise (SME) IPOs, with a target of raising ₹2,768 crore. The largest mainboard IPO comes from EAAA India Alternatives, aiming for ₹1,200 crore. Other participants include SFC Environmental Technologies with a ₹667.53 crore offer and MK Sons Fine Jewels planning to raise ₹275.40 crore.

articles.title: Nifty outlook bearish, but near-term recovery in sight: Analysts
articles.desc: The Nifty index fell over 2% amid sustained selling pressures with technical indicators signaling support levels. Analysts have identified crucial resistance levels and potential near-term recovery points for the index. Several stocks have shown strength and recommendations have been made for buying opportunities. Additionally, bearish momentum remains evident in specific sectors while futures strategies are advised. Overall, investors are encouraged to adopt a cautious approach during this volatile period.

articles.title: Ind AS 118: India Inc gears up for big changes to financial reporting
articles.desc: India’s largest companies are preparing for the implementation of Ind AS 118, which may impact financial reporting. Changes include new classifications for income and expenses, and new operating profit reporting methods. Companies face challenges due to complex requirements and the need for system adjustments. Audit committees are discussing transition plans while awaiting final rules and guidance from regulatory bodies.

articles.title: Dr Reddy's bets on generic semaglutide, biosimilars
articles.desc: Dr Reddy's domestic formulations business grew in the September quarter, while Revlimid sales declined in North America. A relaunch of generic semaglutide and the US launch of abatacept biosimilar are anticipated for future growth. The company aims to sell millions of pens for semaglutide with a focus on international markets. Furthermore, an expanding biosimilars portfolio aims to strengthen its position beyond traditional generics.

articles.desc: The industry body of NBFCs has told the Insurance Regulatory and Development Authority of India (IRDAI) that the proposed commission caps of 2% for credit life and 5% for credit health insurance would make credit-linked insurance distribution unviable, given distribution costs are about 32% of the premium.

articles.title: Insurance commission: IRDAI extends time for feedback to October 31
articles.desc: The regulator is engaging with different stakeholder groups and has not reached a conclusion on the proposals, IRDAI chairman Ajay Seth had said recently. The objective is to move towards a more efficient regime without disrupting existing businesses or livelihoods. Some stakeholders have sought a longer transition period, while others have raised concerns about low-ticket policies, Seth had said. Larger insurers, smaller companies and new entrants have different concerns, as do various categories of insurance distributors.

articles.title: AI narrative needs to change for India: K Balasubramanian, CEO, Citibank India
articles.desc: Long-term capital-gains tax is a big factor on the equity side. On direct investment, the trade agreements are going to be a big positive. Trade agreements create potentially important UK-India and EU-India corridors. We have been doing a lot of work identifying companies that could benefit and engage with clients. For Citi, that opportunity can flow through services and markets and potentially through investment-banking transactions as multinational companies raise capital in India, says K Balasubramanian, CEO, Citibank India.

articles.title: RBI data centre to strengthen payment systems, cyber resilience
articles.desc: The Reserve Bank of India inaugurated a new sovereign data centre to enhance the resilience of financial services and reduce reliance on third-party cloud providers. Prime Minister Narendra Modi also inaugurated a cybersecurity training institute, which will develop expertise in emerging technologies. The data centre will support critical systems like RTGS and NEFT for efficient financial transactions.

articles.title: ‘Very high’ expectations from India-EU FTA, says Rotterdam port chief
articles.desc: Boudewijn Siemons, CEO of the Port of Rotterdam, expressed high expectations for the India-EU free trade agreement. He highlighted the importance of collaboration between ports and nations to facilitate global trade. Siemons conveyed his optimism about increased business opportunities between Europe and India. Negotiations for the free trade agreement have concluded, with hopes to sign it by year-end. The implementation of the agreement is anticipated for next year.

articles.title: Gabon says access to social media restored after eight-month ban
articles.desc: The authorities had justified the ban by saying online content was fuelling conflict, while the opposition had condemned it as an abuse of power.

articles.title: Cities cannot be governed from state capitals, need empowered local governments: NITI Aayog's Rajiv Gauba
articles.desc: Rajiv Gauba emphasized the need for reforms in urban governance during the National Urban Conclave. He highlighted the importance of empowering city governments and proposed directly elected mayors for better governance. The projected increase in India's urban population demands significant infrastructure and service management changes. Gauba called for improved municipal revenues and the adoption of the Model Tenancy Act to support affordable housing.

articles.desc: Peter Lynch’s investing advice centres on understanding a company before buying its stock. The legendary Fidelity Magellan Fund manager stresses researching business fundamentals, growth prospects and financials rather than investing based on popularity or hearsay.

articles.desc: The tech billionaire accuses Ukraine of violating its terms of service by using the network for military activity.

articles.title: Cultivation of large cardamom emerges as a lucrative option for higher income from limited land
articles.desc: A farmer in Himachal Pradesh's Bilaspur district has cultivated large cardamom for 20 years, producing 2-3 quintals annually on about one bigha of land. Priced at around Rs 1.8 lakh per quintal, the crop offers an alternative income source for farmers with reliable irrigation, according to the agriculture department.

articles.title: Mcap of 8 of top-10 firms erodes by Rs 1.55 lakh cr; HDFC Bank, Bajaj Fin biggest laggards
articles.desc: Recently, the market witnessed a downturn, with eight of the leading firms in India suffering major valuation losses. The declines of HDFC Bank and Bajaj Finance were particularly striking. The BSE Sensex plummeted by 1,605.44 points, indicating a bearish atmosphere across equities. While Tata Consultancy Services and Larsen & Toubro showed some gains, the overall trend remained negative.

articles.title: F&O Talk: Nifty plunged 2% this week. Are charts indicating a deeper sell-off?
articles.desc: SBI Securities’ Sudeep Shah expects continued weakness in Indian equities as FII positioning, rising volatility and technical indicators point to further pressure. He identifies key Nifty support and resistance levels and flags IT as a relatively stronger sector.

articles.title: Warren Buffett’s 6 golden rules for investors after retirement
articles.desc: Warren Buffett’s retirement advice focuses on low-cost index investing, paying off high-interest debt, maintaining cash reserves, staying within one’s circle of competence and living frugally. His long-standing principles offer lessons on building wealth, managing risk and making sound financial decisions.

articles.title: India's private capex pipeline surges 39% to Rs 99.7 lakh crore, risks rise: Report
articles.desc: India's private capital expenditure pipeline reached Rs 99.7 lakh crore in September 2026, marking a 39% increase. Manufacturing and electricity constituted the largest components of this pipeline, while the services sector showed rapid growth. A significant concentration of investments appeared in specific states and industries, with eight sectors accounting for 80% of the total. Maharashtra significantly increased its share of the pipeline, indicating a focus on regional development.

articles.desc: Middleton in Teesdale has no mains gas supply so many residents use expensive heating oil.

articles.desc: Some businesses say they want to see employment costs come down in the October Budget.

articles.title: 11 Penny stocks surged up to 180% in 3 months. Do you own any?
articles.desc: Eleven low-priced stocks with market caps below Rs 1,000 crore and share prices under Rs 20 have gained up to 181% over three months. Kapil Raj Finance and Tuni Textile Mills led the list, according to ACE Equity data.

articles.title: FPIs withdraw Rs 48,056 cr from equities in Oct so far amid elevated crude oil prices
articles.desc: Foreign investors withdrew significant funds from Indian equities in October amid concerns over inflation and crude oil prices. Despite this, there were signs of moderation in selling with two days of net buying. The overall FPI outflows from equities in 2026 have reached notable levels compared to previous years. Market participants are closely monitoring upcoming macroeconomic developments including US GDP data.

articles.desc: Chancellor John Healey may need to raise money to boost his fiscal headroom - BBC Verify examines what options could be on the table.

articles.title: MSME business confidence improves despite rising input costs, manufacturing sentiment strongest: SIDBI
articles.desc: India's micro, small, and medium enterprises (MSMEs) are exhibiting a strong sense of optimism for business conditions, evidenced by an uptick in the MSME Business Confidence Index. The manufacturing sector specifically showed promising growth, advancing from 59.5 to 61.0 this quarter. Both trading and services sectors are also experiencing a surge in positive sentiment, suggesting a bright future for all sectors amidst ongoing challenges.

articles.title: Swiggy may rebound to Rs 190, but charts do not signal a trend reversal: LKP’s Vatsal Bhuva
articles.desc: LKP Securities’ Vatsal Bhuva sees continued downside risks for Nifty and Bank Nifty, while identifying potential rebounds in Swiggy and HDFC Bank. He also recommends Oriental Hotels and Apollo Hospitals, citing improving technical indicators and favourable chart setups.

articles.title: Dividends & stock splits: L&T Tech, Shriram Finance among 24 stocks turning ex-record date this week. Do you own?
articles.desc: As many as 24 companies will turn ex-record date for dividends, stock splits and rights issues during the week starting October 26. Key names include Shriram Finance, CRISIL, Cyient, Chennai Petroleum and L&T Technology Services.

articles.title: Jio IPO GMP today: All eyes on telecom major’s mega listing this week. What is grey market signalling?
articles.desc: Jio Platforms will list on October 28, with a grey market premium of Rs 247 indicating a potential 22.07% listing gain. The Rs 30,213-crore IPO was subscribed over 22 times, led by strong institutional demand.

articles.title: IDFC First Bank Q2 profit nearly triples to Rs 1,045 crore
articles.desc: IDFC First Bank’s Q2 net profit tripled to Rs 1,045 crore, supported by strong loan and fee growth. Net interest income rose 21%, while net interest margin declined to 5.6%.

articles.title: Post Jio boost: 5 IPOs to raise Rs 2,581 crore next week alongside India's biggest listing
articles.desc: In a bustling week for the IPO market, five mainboard offerings are set to debut between October 26 and 30, aiming to amass an impressive Rs 2,581 crore. EAAA India Alternatives spearheads the launches, while Jio Platforms makes its entrance on October 28. Other notable entries include SFC Environmental Technologies and BLS Polymers on October 27, with MK Sons Fine Jewels and Bombay Coated and Special Steels following closely.

articles.title: Sebi to revamp short-selling, securities lending rules
articles.desc: Sebi is reviewing short-selling and securities lending rules to improve liquidity and price discovery. The regulator is also planning reforms in clearing, broker compliance, custodial services and corporate bond market-making to deepen capital markets and reduce compliance costs.

articles.title: Nifty bears tighten grip as crude, geopolitical risks, FII outflows mount: 5 factors to decide D-Street’s fate next week
articles.desc: Indian stock markets faced a setback as crude oil prices soared, triggered by increasing geopolitical tensions in the Middle East. Despite some defensive buying from domestic institutions, foreign investors pulled back. The forthcoming US Federal Reserve meeting is poised to impact global market moods. Investors will be keenly watching industrial production metrics and second-quarter earnings for insights on corporate health, as macroeconomic stability remains crucial for market trends.
